subject: Who signs capex & procurement handoff
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@novusai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who signs capex & procurement handoff

Evan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we promised:

- Summary: NovusAI is focused on reducing per-inference cost for batch and nearline routing; you saw the latency/cost tradeoffs during the demo and liked Redwood's dedicated + fallback model routing idea.
- What we need from you to move pricing/procurement forward: name of the person who signs capex/commit, procurement POC for contract redlines, and security contact for SOC2 evidence. You mentioned CAPEX vs OPEX discussion on your side — helpful to confirm who owns that decision.
- Attachments: sending our MOP (operational playbook) and SOC2 summary for your security team to skim.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min alignment with your budget owner + procurement to confirm approval timeline and contract model (reserved vs committed).
2) Karthik will prepare a 1-page cost sketch with sustained throughput numbers and a short list of fallback models.
3) Marcus will gather the SOC2 artifacts your security team asked about if they want deeper evidence.

Can you confirm the names/roles for: (A) budget approver who signs capital/commit, (B) procurement contact for redlines, (C) security reviewer for SOC2? Also, is the target approval window still early April?

Thanks — happy to adapt cadence.

— Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: redwood-mop-v1.pdf (Operational playbook, 6 pages), soc2-summary.pdf (1 page)
From: Evan Holt <evan.holt@novusai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novusai.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Who signs capex & procurement handoff

Irene — great demo, thanks to you and the team. Answering your questions: 

A) Budget approver / signer: Maria Lopez, CFO (maria.lopez@novusai.com). She owns CAPEX approvals; for smaller reserved commitments finance can sign but Maria wants to see the cost/ROI sketch first.
B) Procurement/contact for redlines: procurement@novusai.com (Samir Patel is the lead there). Please loop them on contract drafts.
C) Security reviewer: that's Clara Nguyen (clara.nguyen@novusai.com) on our Information Security team; she asked for a SOC2 summary and brief runbook for incident response.

Timeline: Maria is targeting an April 12th approval date aligned to her monthly capex review. If we can get a short cost sketch + draft SOW by next Friday (Mar 24), we'll try to include it in the packet.

I'll cc Samir on the next email. He may request standard procurement templates (we can accept DocuSign).

— Evan
Director of ML Infrastructure | NovusAI
